decided: Jeremy, 2026-11-03 (recipe bump, seed change intended, relabel pooling rule)
supersedes: the single semantic policy named by stimulus_angle_convention_v1.json declared_in (revision 1: citrus.protocol.semantic.v2 only). That file is unchanged and stays pinned by unified H5 admissions v5 to v7.
hash_rule: protocol_semantic_hash = 'sha256:' + hex(sha256(canonical_json_bytes)) over the exact recorded bytes; a consumer never re-canonicalises or regenerates them
mixing: any other combination is corruption and is refused; semantic.v3 under the legacy convention is refused; an unknown policy (for example citrus.protocol.semantic.v4) is refused

semantic_v3.changes_from_v2: normalization_policy is citrus.protocol.semantic.v3. Chaser steps (stimulus_mode_id 12, parameters.type ProtocolChaserParams) additionally hash the fields below. Everything else in the envelope and identity is hashed exactly as in v2.

newly_hashed.rule: required on every chaser step; null when the authored z_eff_mm is 0 (the chaser keeps its current value), otherwise a scaled number with unit mm and a positive value. The step's own value drives loom size and the visual-angle drive, never the arena's.
required on every chaser step; a scaled number with unit mm and a non-negative value (step level)
required on every phase of type chase (v2 hashed it for retreat phases only); a non-empty string
required on every chaser that has appearance_drive, even when loom_mode_id is None (0)

semantic_v3.trial_index: stays schema_version 3 / citrus.protocol.trial_index.v3; adds chaser features.target.z_eff_mm (null when 0) and the chase-motion target_reference inside objects v3 leaves open; its hash changes because it embeds the semantic hash, and the execution-index hash changes because it embeds the trial-index hash
semantic_v3.seeds: per_session_v1 chaser seeds are sha256('citrus.chaser_schedule.seed.v1' | session_uuid | semantic_hash | step_index | occurrence). They change with the semantic hash for dimbatman, goodbatbadbat and redbat; because session_uuid is included no two sessions ever shared a seed under v2 or v3, so a v3 session is a replicate of a v2 session in the same sense as two v2 sessions. fixed_v1 seeds are unchanged. The change is intended (Jeremy, 2026-11-03).

relabel_pooling_rule.scope: protocol_semantic_hash grouping only; trial-index and execution-index hashes are never joined across policies
relabel_pooling_rule.rule: a v2 recording joins a v3 protocol group only if (1) its recorded protocol_semantic_json bytes hash to its recorded v2 protocol_semantic_hash, (2) the byte substring "normalization_policy":"citrus.protocol.semantic.v2" occurs exactly once in those bytes, and (3) sha256 of the bytes with that substring replaced by "normalization_policy":"citrus.protocol.semantic.v3" equals the v3 group's protocol_semantic_hash. Otherwise the recording stays in its own v2 group.
relabel_pooling_rule.inputs: recorded bytes only; never a re-serialisation or a fresh regeneration
relabel_pooling_rule.expected: matches every label-only protocol; never matches a protocol whose v3 identity adds chaser fields (a v2 recording does not show which values it ran with)
